name: Pomodoro Timer
summary: Focus and break timer with classic Pomodoro cycles — runs entirely in your browser.
description: Start a focus session, take short breaks, and insert a long break after a configurable number of sessions. Customize durations, pause/reset/skip, optional desktop alerts, and a live tab title countdown. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: What is the default schedule?
faqs.answer: 25 minutes focus, 5 minutes short break, 15 minutes long break after every 4 focus sessions. You can change all of these.

faqs.question: Do alerts work offline?
faqs.answer: The timer runs locally. Desktop notifications need browser permission and may require the tab to stay open.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Timing runs entirely in your browser.
